scenes.setting: Above the gray fog from the doll-filled bedroom (visions only: the puppet craftsman, Emlyn White gazing affectionately at his figurines): divining the big doll's origin — Emlyn truly is a figurine fanatic — then 'scenes of death in ten years' returns nothing: a law-abiding vampire family
scenes.text_anchor: No one had died in the last ten years at 48 Riverbay Avenue!

scenes.setting: Riverbay Police Station archives (sneaked in among thieves and drunkards, gas lamp lit with no light leaking) — ten years of missing-persons records: nothing; then home to Minsk Street to pen the opening move, a tip-off letter to Detective Stuart placing Emlyn on Tuteva Street

Captain's cabin of the Blue Avenger on the Sonia Sea: Alger finally digests the Seafarer potion and sketches his ambition — hidden advancement to Ocean Songster, a secret return to an ancient island, a Cardinal's robe — and wonders about the face-down card beside Mr. Fool's hand
scenes.text_anchor: After nearly four months, his Seafarer potion had finally been digested!

scenes.setting: 15 Minsk Street at bedtime: Klein's Seer intuition flags days of 'forgetting' to divine the Werewolf characteristic and Biological Poison Bottle — the Rose School's Chained God may punish deduction — so tomorrow's test will be the bottle alone
